precedence: Fixed GameData remains primary for exact numbers; PRTS supplies behavior and selector semantics; deterministic implementation is traced to simulator code.

pages.title: 乌萨斯平民
facts: Enemy-stored Ursus Civilian is a neutral unit.
Enemy-class neutral units are not blocked by character-class units.
Safe protected-target arrival does not deduct objective life; death deducts objective life.
Ursus Civilian cannot attack and is not ordinarily blocked.
It is not counted in annihilation.

pages.title: 选择器
facts: Faction classes include ALLY, ENEMY, and NEUTRAL.
For an ALLY-side selector, the opposing side is ENEMY; for an ENEMY-side selector, the opposing side includes ALLY and NEUTRAL.
As a common subjective-side default, an enemy unit that can select ally units also selects neutral units.

pages.title: 感染者纠察官
facts: The Infected Patrol Officer can normally attack Ursus Civilian and Talulah the Fighter within radius 1.2.
This is a source-backed special target capability; do not generalize radius 1.2 to all enemies.

pages.title: 道路障碍物
facts: Roadblock is an enemy-faction device with blocking radius 0.4472.
It specifically blocks Ursus Civilian and Talulah the Fighter from advancing and can be destroyed by our units.
This device blocking is distinct from ordinary character blocking.

unknowns: Exact client target priority between operators and neutral protected targets remains UNKNOWN.
Special skills, auras, and recovery effects that target neutrals require individual evidence.
Behavior for protected target families other than those named by roadblock evidence remains UNKNOWN.
Exact continuous-frame client blocking and timing remain UNKNOWN.
